We assist major corporations worldwide with strategy, acquisitions, organizational design and performance improvement. We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We believe that diversity, inclusion, and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities, and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH You’ll be part of Bain’s Global Coaching Team, a collaborative and high-impact team that provides and enables transformational coaching, experiences, and training to help Bainies perform at their full potential, navigate their careers with intention, and deliver extraordinary results. The Global Coaching team sits within the Global Talent Engagement department, which champions a transformative approach to belonging, resilience, and wellbeing that enables our diverse teams to collaborate seamlessly, achieve exceptional results, and grow together.  We bring together coaching professionals with expertise in strategy consulting, executive coaching, leadership development, and career transitions. The team partners with local office and regional leadership, Talent, and Learning teams globally to ensure Bain leaders at all levels have access to world-class support, insights, and tools. Position Summary The Senior Manager, EMEA, Global Coaching will play a critical role in delivering Bain’s global coaching strategy in EMEA by providing guidance and coaching to Bain employees (with an emphasis on those in leadership roles), leading training/group coaching sessions, supporting clients with priority junior executive talent needs, and advising office talent teams on best practices for individualized coaching programs, career/departure support, and building coaching capabilities in the line.  This includes overseeing and delivering high-quality coaching experiences across the Global Coaching team’s main areas of work: •      Coaching: individual, on-demand, programmatic, and group coaching for key talent populations and leaders within Bain •      Departure Support: career transition coaching and job search support, as well as talent identification for key senior roles at client/alumni organisations •      Capability Building: in collaboration with the global training team and local office contacts, deliver coaching and career planning training Responsibilities Local office stakeholder engagement (20%) •      Act as trusted advisor to local leadership, careers and departure teams in several assigned EMEA offices (includes HR, staffing, Career/Departure Partner, etc.) on their nuanced talent needs •      Regularly analyze data and metrics and elevate insights to ensure best in class support Coaching (30%) •      Deliver 1:1 and group coaching engagements for Bain employees, with a bias towards more senior coachees (Manager+); stay current with our offerings and trends/themes among those we support •      Work with EMEA and Global Coaching leadership to set aspirations, goals, and metrics to measure success in assigned offices  •      Collaborate with stakeholders to identify key coaching needs for local talent populations  Career and departure support (30%) •      Provide one-on-one confidential career support with an emphasis on priority populations •      Build relationships with employers, clients, recruitment agencies, and alumni to keep pulse on industry job trends/climate and facilitating introductions of departing employees and alumni •      Assist Bain clients and alumni with mid-level talent needs by helping to identify departing Bain employee or alumni candidates for relevant open roles  •      Use departure data and feedback to identify trends, inform decision-making, and enhance the Bain departure experience Capability building (10%) •      Deliver training and workshops to build leadership and coaching capability across the firm’s talent •      Facilitate sessions on career-related topics for priority coaching populations Regional and Global team collaboration (10%) •      Coordinate and collaborate with the regional and global coaching team to share best practices, learnings and help build the global coaching brand in EMEA and beyond •      Contribute to/lead regional or global initiatives to further grow and innovate global coaching in line with the global strategy PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS:  Bain seeks a bright, passionate, and engaging individual who will be a highly credible and inspirational leader. This individual will be team-oriented and provide bold thinking to help stimulate an energetic approach to coaching and deliver dynamic results.   Education: Required •      ICF Coaching Certification •      Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent Preferred •      Masters in Business, Org, Psych (or a related field)  Experience Required •      10+ years of relevant experience  •      Work in executive, leadership and/or career coaching •      Exposure to professional services, corporate coaching, or executive search •      Experience designing, leading and implementing coaching programmes in complex organisations •      Experience using technology and data to enhance coaching or learning programs •      Proven ability to develop well-planned strategies and achieve goals within tight timelines Preferred •      Experience in a consulting firm and/or with the post-consulting job market Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Required •      Coaching know-how: familiarity with coaching modalities that unlock transformation; experience supporting others at career inflection points, while navigating a job search or during times of transition with a strong growth and future-focused mindset •      Flexible and dynamic: ability to work in a dynamic coaching team with a deep commitment to helping others succeed. Comfort with ambiguity, flexibility across global contexts, and agility to evolve offerings in response to firm needs •      Data-driven: Delivering insights to stakeholders based on analysis of quantitative and qualitative data, comfort operating within a data-driven environment •      Influencing and relationship building skills: Strong influencing skills and relationship development ability across all levels of the organization to build credibility and implement change. Underpinned by effective, succinct and professional communication  •      Language and culture: Fluent in English and another language – French, German or Spanish. Possess an international mindset, with experience navigating cultural differences Core personal characteristics include: •      Servant-Leadership Mindset •      High Self Awareness •      Strong Ethics •      Humility •      Empathy Preferred •      Market knowledge: An in-depth knowledge of one or more EMEA job markets •      Global reach: Given the global nature of the broader team, preference for candidates who have experience working across multiple regions or in prior global roles ABOUT US Bain & Company is a global consultancy that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 63 offices in 38 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition, and redefine industries. We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster, and more enduring outcomes. Our 10-year commitment to invest more than $1 billion in pro bono services brings our talent, expertise, and insight to organizations tackling today’s urgent challenges in education, racial equity, social justice, economic development, and the environment. We earned a gold rating from EcoVadis, the leading platform for environmental, social, and ethical performance ratings for global supply chains, putting us in the top 2% among other consulting firms. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.

Tier 1: Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments Tier 2: UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers Tier 3 or no tier indicated: All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply. Background You are invited to join a team of dedicated development professionals whose primary role is to support the Philippines to achieve the 2030 Agenda. As part of the UNDP team your focus will be to work with multiple stakeholders to find the country specific solutions that lead to resilience to crises, and to ensure no one is left behind - and we reach those furthest behind first. In Mindanao, UNDP has played a critical role in supporting various peace processes, including technical and operational assistance during the peace negotiations as well as in the implementation of peace agreements towards realizing peace dividends for communities in conflict-affected areas. This accompaniment process has included substantive technical and operational support for conflict-prevention, governance and peacebuilding. Specifically, the Peacebuilding Cluster has implemented technical and operational support for capacity-strengthening on conflict-sensitivity and peace-promotion among regional government institutions; community resilience and socio-economic empowerment assistance for communities most affected by armed conflict; and support for peace process mechanisms, including on key components of the Normalization process. In addition, projects under the Cluster also focus on strengthening meaningful participation and empowerment of sectoral groups (women, youth, Indigenous Peoples, and internally displaced persons) through the mainstreaming and operationalization of the Women, Peace and Security and Youth, Peace and Security agenda. To lead the Peacebuilding Cluster, UNDP Philippines seeks to engage a Peacebuilding Project Manager. In this role, UNDP is looking for individuals with strong analytical, planning, and implementation skills who can address the interconnections, choices, and linkages across multiple issues and sectors in the Bangsamoro region. We seek candidates who can apply global best practices to the national context and who are enthusiastic, motivated, and committed to making a positive contribution to peacebuilding and development in the Bangsamoro region and the Philippines. The successful candidate must possess substantial knowledge and demonstrated experience in managing the implementation of development projects, particularly in the field of peacebuilding. The Project Manager will help shape UNDP initiatives and projects focused on conflict prevention, preventing and countering violent extremism, empowering women, youth, and Indigenous Peoples, promoting social cohesion, and supporting climate security initiatives. In particular, UNDP is seeking a Project Manager who will be based in Cotabato and will lead the day-to-day operations of the Peacebuilding Cluster. The Cluster implements a range of peacebuilding projects, including Phase II of the Programme on Stabilization, Peacebuilding and Resilience in the Bangsamoro (PROSPER Bangsamoro Phase II), initiatives on Preventing Violent Extremism, the Joint Programme on Women, Peace and Security, and other projects that may be assigned. The Project Manager will oversee the work of project staff and coordinate closely with project partners. The incumbent will work collaboratively with colleagues to ensure integrated, effective, and efficient programme delivery. The Project Manager will also engage with other UN agencies, government officials, technical advisors and experts, multilateral and bilateral donors, and civil society organizations to support the successful implementation of UNDP peacebuilding projects. Duties And Responsibilities The Project Manager will undertake day-to-day management of the peacebuilding cluster projects. S/he shall carry out the following tasks: Ensure Strategic Management Of The Project And Provide Day-to-day Financial And Administrative Support For The Delivery Of The Project’s Activities Focusing On Achievement Of The Following Results Provide quality leadership in the overall coordination and management of the project; Contribute to the development and monitoring of action plans in order to identify and resolve issues on financial delivery towards the full and optimal utilization of project funds; Lead the identification of project issues, challenges and risks, appropriate recommendations and implements them; Prepare progress monitoring reports (e.g. donor reports), activity designs, briefing papers, technical reports, meeting documentation, situation updates, official correspondences, M&E documents, and other documentation as may be required in project implementation; Organize and participate in workshops, needs assessments, consultations, planning sessions and provide technical inputs as maybe necessary; Undertake communication assignments such as writing of articles, press releases, development of knowledge products and other related activities; Mentor and coach team members as they perform their duties; Develop and maintain effective working relationships and coordination with key counterparts to ensure the successful implementation of the project : Network and build strong working relations with Government, UN, and donor partners; Establish, develop and maintain mutually beneficial strategic partnerships with NGOs, civil society and community groups, the press and media, the business sector, etc.; Establish networks with experts of UN System, international development organizations, and prominent private sector organizations; Link with other UNDP projects and work closely with the UNDP Programme teams and Operations team to support efficient delivery of project activities in line with strategic objectives. Oversee the successful implementation of all the components of the project : Overall project management; Manage the realization of project outputs agreed upon through activities; Provide direction and guidance to project team(s)/ responsible party (ies); Liaise with the Project Board or its appointed Project Assurance roles to assure the overall direction and integrity of the project; Identify and obtain any support and advice required for the management, planning and control of the project; Responsible for project administration; Liaise with any suppliers. Implementing The Project Plan the activities of the project and monitor progress against the initial quality criteria; Mobilize goods and services to initiative activities, including drafting TORs and work specifications; Monitor events as determined in the Monitoring & Communication Plan, and update the plan as required; Manage requests for the provision of financial resources by UNDP, using advance of funds, direct payments, or reimbursement using the FACE (Fund Authorization and Certificate of Expenditures); Monitor financial resources and accounting to ensure accuracy and reliability of financial reports; Manage and monitor the project risks as initially identified in the Project Brief appraised by the LPAC, submit new risks to the Project Board for consideration and decision on possible actions if required; Update the status of these risks by maintaining the Project Risks Log; Be responsible for managing issues and requests for change by maintaining an Issues Log; Prepare the Project Quarterly Progress Report (progress against planned activities, update on Risks and issues, expenditures) and submit the report to the Project Board and Project Assurance; Prepare the Annual Review Report, and submit the report to the Project Board and the Outcome Board; Based on the review, prepare the AWP for the following year, as well as Quarterly Plans if required. Closing The Project Prepare Final Project Review Reports to be submitted to the Project Board and the Outcome Board; Identify follow-on actions and submit them for consideration to the Project Board; Manage the transfer of project deliverables, documents, files, equipment, and materials to national beneficiaries; Prepare final Combined Delivery Report / Financial Reports for signature by UNDP. Support Strategic Partnership Building And Resource Mobilization Establish and maintain a strategic understanding of and engagement with all the relevant institutions, including establishing contact and developing strategic partnerships with other UN agencies, government institutions, donors, NGOs, IFIs, the private sector, academia, civil society, and other stakeholders and beneficiaries at the national, regional, and local levels; Participate in meetings with donors, prepare and deliver presentations of project results, and follow up with relevant counterparts if requested by the supervisor; Implement resource mobilization strategies to achieve project outcomes that include facilitating liaisons with potential financing agencies and institutions to strengthen relationships and raise funds. Identify new funding opportunities for furthering the project ideas. Contribute to knowledge management and information sharing in the UNDP country office: Organize training for the project personnel to enhance their capacities in the technical matters of the thematic area of the project; Identify, evaluate, synthesize, and document lessons learned and best practices directly linked to the project goals and activities. Develop knowledge sharing materials and respond to related queries. Contribute substantively to knowledge networks and communities of practice within the thematic area of the project; Develop and carry out a personal learning plan. The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organization. Institutional arrangements Under the overall guidance of the Team Leader of the Peace and Stabilization Programme Team and the UNDP Head of Cotabato Field Office, the Project Manager will work with key partners and stakeholders to deliver distinct outputs of the project, to ensure quality implementation- from capacity building, management of human and financial resources, oversee the monitoring and evaluation, and communication framework towards achievement of delivery targets. The Project Manager will work closely with the project team, Peace and Stabilization Programme Team, and UNDP CO teams and project stakeholders. Willingness to relocate to Cotabato City is required. Competencies Core Competencies Achieve Results: LEVEL 3: Set and align challenging, achievable objectives for multiple projects, have lasting impact Think Innovatively: LEVEL 3: Proactively mitigate potential risks, develop new ideas to solve complex problems Learn Continuously: LEVEL 3: Create and act on opportunities to expand horizons, diversify experiences Adapt with Agility: LEVEL 3: Proactively initiate and champion change, manage multiple competing demands Act with Determination: LEVEL 3: Think beyond immediate task/barriers and take action to achieve greater results Engage and Partner: LEVEL 3: Political savvy, navigate complex landscape, champion inter-agency collaboration Enable Diversity and Inclusion: LEVEL 3: Appreciate benefits of diverse workforce and champion inclusivity People Management The posts will be supervising personnel which includes the Project Analyst, Admin and Finance Associate, Project Assistant and Driver. UNDP People Management Competencies can be found in the dedicated site. Cross-Functional & Technical Competencies Business Direction and Strategy : Systems Thinking: Ability to use objective problem analysis and judgement to understand how interrelated elements coexist within an overall process or system, and to consider how altering one element can impact on other parts of the system Business Development: Knowledge Facilitation: Ability to animate individuals and groups, internally and externally, and to design and facilitate activities, to share and exchange knowledge, information and ideas. Knowledge of tools and approaches to stimulate active participation, contribution, and exchange Business Management: Project Management: Ability to plan, organize, prioritize and control resources, procedures and protocols to achieve specific goals Business Management: Partnerships Management: Build and maintain partnerships with wide networks of stakeholders, Governments, civil society and private sector partners, experts and others in line with UNDP strategy and policies Business Management: Resource Management: Allocate and use resources in a strategic or tactical way in line with business needs and priorities and principles of accountability and integrity 2030 Agenda: Peace Conflict Prevention, Peacebuilding and Responsive Institutions : Community engagement for prevention, response, and social cohesion Business Management: Communication: Communicate in a clear, concise and unambiguous manner both through written and verbal communication; to tailor messages and choose communication methods depending on the audience. Ability to manage communications internally and externally, through media, social media and other appropriate channels Education Required Skills and Experience Advanced university degree (master’s degree or equivalent) in Social Sciences, including Public Administration, Polit

review_candidates.title: Project Manager
review_candidates.description: Are you ready to lead missions, not just manage tasks? At EDGES ENTERPRISE LTD , we build digital products, platforms, and systems that solve real problems. As our footprint grows, we are looking for a Project Manager who can bring structure, momentum, and direction to multiple projects and teams. This is an opportunity to work at the centre of execution, where ideas become products and plans become results. 🧠 YOU'LL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF ... You enjoy bringing order to complexity. You naturally think about what needs to happen next, who needs to make it happen, and how everything connects. You understand how to align different personalities and teams toward a single, unified goal. You communicate clearly, follow through on commitments, and take radical ownership of outcomes. You care just as much about the microscopic details as you do about the bigger picture. 🎯 WHAT YOU'LL DO You will oversee multiple software projects, acting as the connective tissue between: • Software Engineers & Designers • Product Teams & Management • Key Project Stakeholders Your core responsibilities will include: • Planning, structuring, and setting milestones for projects • Tracking deliverables and identifying/resolving blockers before they escalate • Managing changing priorities with calm and clarity • Keeping teams aligned, motivated, and accountable • Moving projects seamlessly from idea → execution → delivery 🚀 WHAT YOU'LL EXPERIENCE • 100% Remote : Work from wherever you can consistently deliver your best work. • Real Ownership: Your decisions will directly influence how our teams operate and how our products ship. • Dynamic Challenges: Work across different products, technologies, and scales. • Growth: Take on greater responsibility and shape the culture as EDGES ENTERPRISE LTD scales. • Compensation : ₦250,000 – ₦350,000 per month, based on experience, capability, and demonstrated execution. ⚡ THE EXECUTION TEST We don’t just want to read about how you work; we want to see it. To apply, please follow these steps exactly: 1. Send an email to contact@edgesenterprise.com 2. Use this exact subject line: Project Manager: Ready to Lead at EDGES ENTERPRISE LTD 3. Attach your CV (PDF preferred). 4.In the body of the email, answer this in exactly 3 sentences : *"What is the most complex project conflict you've ever had to resolve, what did you personally do, and what was the outcome?"* Keep your response specific. Show us the situation, your approach, your actions, and the result. Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed. We are looking for intentionality, clarity, and decisive action. If you are ready to take ownership of projects, teams, and execution, we want to hear from you. EDGES ENTERPRISE LTD **Pro Tip:** We review applications on a rolling basis. Early, intentional applications are strongly encouraged.

review_candidates.title: Oral and maxillofacial surgery specilaist
review_candidates.description: Company Description The Ministry of Health (MOH) in Saudi Arabia is committed to delivering high-quality, integrated, and comprehensive healthcare services to all residents. Its strategy focuses on promoting justice and equality in access to care, ensuring that general and specialized health services are available and financially sustainable. The MOH works to improve population health through national programs targeting key issues such as non-communicable diseases, nutrition, reproductive health, tobacco use, HIV/AIDS, traffic accidents, and injuries. It also leads the formulation of health policies, including health insurance, through bodies such as the Health Services Council, and pursues diversified, effective financing sources to support the healthcare system. Role Description This full-time, on-site role is for an Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery Specialist based in Seoul, South Korea, working under the auspices of the Ministry of Health Saudi Arabia. The specialist will perform advanced surgical procedures involving the mouth, jaws, face, and neck, including trauma management, corrective jaw surgery, pathology removal, and implant-related surgeries. Daily responsibilities include assessing patients, interpreting diagnostic imaging, developing treatment plans, performing surgeries in operating rooms and clinics, and monitoring postoperative recovery. The role also involves collaborating with multidisciplinary teams, adhering to evidence-based clinical guidelines, maintaining detailed medical records, and participating in quality improvement and patient safety initiatives. Teaching, mentoring, and contributing to continuing education activities may be part of the role, depending on service needs. Qualifications Clinical expertise in oral and maxillofacial surgery, including management of facial trauma, dentoalveolar surgery, orthognathic procedures, and pathology of the maxillofacial region. Strong diagnostic and treatment planning skills, including proficiency in radiologic interpretation (e.g., CT, CBCT, panoramic imaging) and comprehensive patient assessment. Demonstrated competence in anesthesia and pain management principles relevant to oral and maxillofacial surgery, with a focus on safe perioperative care. Effective communication and collaboration skills for working within multidisciplinary teams and providing clear, compassionate patient counseling. Commitment to evidence-based practice, continuous professional development, and adherence to clinical governance and patient safety standards. Recognized medical or dental degree with specialization in Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery, and eligibility for licensure/registration as a specialist according to relevant regulatory requirements. Experience in tertiary or hospital-based surgical settings; prior work within government or large healthcare systems is an advantage. Ability to work in a culturally diverse environment; proficiency in English required, and willingness to engage with regional language and cultural practices.

review_candidates.title: Mechanical Engineer
review_candidates.description: Advancing careers. Advancing everyday life. Glencore is committed to providing an environment that adheres to the Respect at Work Legislation. Clermont Open Cut is currently seeking an experienced Maintenance Engineer to join our high performing Maintenance & Engineering Department onsite. Located on the western edge of the Bowen Basin, Clermont Open Cut is a high performing truck & shovel operation that produces 12 million tonnes of coal per annum. Clermont Open Cut Operation is a safe, dynamic, and inclusive workplace focused on delivering high performance outcomes. Reporting to the Superintendent Planning and Reliability, you will be responsible for identifying issues effecting reliability and developing maintenance tactics to rectify them. You will work with key stake holders to build and maintain strong working relationships to support effective asset management strategies and systems for the mobile fleet and Coal Handling Facility on site. In this role you will be responsible for: Analyse asset performance data to identify reliability issues and collaborate with stakeholders to develop and implement targeted solutions Perform cost–benefit analyses to justify maintenance projects that enhance asset health and reliability Liaise with OEMs to review product improvements and ensure timely action where required Support the development and implementation of the Safety and Health Management System (SHMS) as it applies to mechanical engineering Demonstrate visible leadership to promote and maintain a safe working environment Provide expert technical guidance to maintenance planning and execution teams Mentor and develop graduate engineers and vacation students, fostering their technical and professional growth Requirements of the role include: Bachelors Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related discipline Minimum 2+ years experience within mining/heavy industry Mobile Equipment reliability experience desirable Experience in maintenance management system (SAP) is essential Experience in Root Cause Analysis facilitation will be highly regarded. Good interpersonal and teamwork skills Strong communication skills QLD Drivers Licence This role requires a safety conscious candidate prepared to challenge the norm, drive continuous improvement and who can demonstrate experience in implementing best practise using a hands-on approach. What we offer: Highly competitive remuneration package and annual short-term incentive bonus Professional development, tailored training opportunities and a generous education assistance program Healthy Lifestyle reimbursement scheme, up to $5000 per year FIFO, DIDO and Residential options available Village Accommodation for DIDO/FIFO. Heavily subsidised Company housing along with a generous local living allowance when residing locally in local community of Clermont. Relocation Assistance Clermont is only one and a quarter hour drive from Emerald, three-and-half hour drive from Mackay and a five-hour drive from Townsville. We have a diverse group of people employed at our operation who choose to commute from multiple locations across Queensland along with those who live locally within the Isaac Region. If you’re passionate and driven, and can operate within a dynamic environment, this is your opportunity to make an impact and join a team focused on fostering a culture that empowers and supports our most valuable asset, our people. Clermont Open Cut isn’t your typical coal mine. See what it’s really like working at Clermont Open Cut by watching our ‘Day in the Life’ video (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EIkynly2VkQ ) Applications close: 20 September 2026 All internal employees should discuss their expression of interest with their Manager prior to applying for this role. Glencore provides unrivalled career and development prospects, great communities and the opportunity to work with leaders in your field.

review_candidates.title: Job | Executive Assistant - Directiesecretariaat Belfius Insurance | Brussel
review_candidates.description: Omschrijving Je ondersteunt twee directieleden van Belfius Insurance - Executive Director Non-Life & Chief Financial Officer - op administratief, organisatorisch en communicatief vlak. Door jouw nauwkeurige, discrete en vooruitziende ondersteuning zorg je voor een vlot en efficiënt verloop van hun dagelijkse werkzaamheden en draag je bij aan de realisatie van de doelstellingen van Belfius Insurance. De job in een notendop Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het proactief beheren en optimaliseren van de agenda’s en het coördineren van de activiteiten van de Executive Director Non-Life en de CFO, inclusief de praktische voorbereiding en opvolging van vergaderingen en dossiers. Je belangrijkste taak is het tijdig en correct timen alsook organiseren van vergaderingen, inclusief het verzamelen, voorbereiden en digitaal verspreiden van alle documentatie met bijzondere aandacht voor confidentialiteit en nauwkeurigheid. Je team bestaat uit de collega’s van het Directiesecretariaat, dat rapporteert aan de Chief of Staff, en jouw rol hierin is die van een centrale spilfiguur die afspraken, informatie en documenten stroomlijnt tussen directie, interne stakeholders en externe partners. Een typische werkdag ziet er als volgt uit: je plant en herplant afspraken, prioriteert verzoeken, bereidt vergaderingen voor, volgt toegewezen dossiers op, verzorgt professionele correspondentie in NL/FR/ENG, bewaakt deadlines en ondersteunt projecten en events. Door jouw ondersteuning en vooruitziende blik ontlast je directieleden van operationele en administratieve werklast zodat hij/zij zich kunnen focussen op strategische beslissingen. Jij hoeft geen witte raaf te zijn Al kan je er bij ons wel één worden. Bij ons mag je volop je vleugels uitslaan als je iemand bent met: Een bachelordiploma en/of een eerste relevante werkervaring als (executive) assistant. Minimum 3 tot 5 jaar is een gelijkaardige rol is een sterke troef. Sterke organisatorische en administratieve skills: je kan complexe agenda’s beheren, prioriteiten scherp stellen, vergaderingen voorbereiden en dossiers nauwgezet opvolgen. Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk, in het Nederlands, Frans en Engels, met een vlotte en professionele pen. Een hoge mate van discretie, integriteit en stressbestendigheid: je gaat zorgvuldig om met gevoelige en vertrouwelijke informatie en blijft kalm en gestructureerd in een dynamische omgeving. Een proactieve, vooruitziende mindset: je anticipeert op noden, denkt mee over verbeteringen, neemt spontaan initiatief om zaken te structureren en bewaakt termijnen en afspraken. Digitale maturiteit: je werkt vlot met Office-tools (Teams, Outlook, Word, Excel & Powerpoint), ervaring met ERP-tools en documentenautomatisering. Je staat open tot gebruik van nieuwe ontwikkelingen in AI om je taken te vereenvoudigen. Je scoort extra met: Uitstekende tweetaligheid (Nederlands/Frans) en een zeer goede kennis van Engels. Ervaring in het ondersteunen van directie- of bestuursorganen (Directiecomité, Raad van Bestuur…) binnen een financiële of verzekeringsomgeving. Ervaring met stakeholdermanagement. Belfius koestert zijn talenten Behalve de kans om elke dag te shinen, bieden wij jou een fulltime contract van onbepaalde duur met: Een mooi loon aangevuld met een innovatief aanbod om een persoonlijk budget samen te stellen dat je kan besteden volgens je voorkeuren (bv. wagen, fiets, pc, smartphone, tablet, huisvesting onder bepaalde voorwaarden) en extralegale voordelen zoals maaltijdcheques, personeelsvoordeel op eigen producten en diensten, en een hospitalisatie- en groepsverzekering. Mogelijkheden te over om je te ontwikkelen door een brede waaier aan opleidingen en carrièrekansen in de hele Belfius-groep. Een goede werk-privé balans dankzij flexibele uren, de combinatie kantoor- en thuiswerk en een aantrekkelijk aantal vakantiedagen. Een moderne werkplek in het hart van Brussel met een coole fitness, een lekker gezond restaurant en gezellige ontmoetingsruimtes, dit alles op wandelafstand van de winkelstraat, het treinstation Brussel-Noord en de metrohalte Rogier.
